title: Embed defaults data-auritus-api to script origin, which breaks CDN-hosted sites
description:
Discovered while integrating Auritus into Pilobol.us (2026-09-14/15), a CDN-hosted static site (Amplify) with no server-side proxy to the Auritus API.

embed/src/index.ts apiBaseFromElement():
  const explicit = element.getAttribute('data-auritus-api')?.trim();
  if (explicit) return explicit.replace(/\/$/, '');
  if (element instanceof HTMLScriptElement) {
    const url = new URL(element.src);
    return url.origin;  // <-- falls back to the SCRIPT's own origin
  }
  return location.origin;

The embed snippet README shows at the top of README.md:
  <script src="https://aurit.us/embed.js" data-auritus-site-key="YOUR_SITE_KEY" ...></script>
with NO data-auritus-api attribute. Following that snippet literally (as I
did) means the embed's API base silently resolves to https://aurit.us itself
-- the site key's OWN origin, which is a static Next.js site with no /jobs
route. Every createJob call then fails with a generic, unhelpful
'TypeError: Failed to fetch' at AuritusApiClient.createJob, and because boot()
never reaches mountPlayer() on that path, NO player element appears at all --
no error state, no fallback UI, nothing. From a reader's perspective the
narration feature simply doesn't exist on the page; there is no signal in
the DOM or a casual console check to explain why.

This cost a full debugging cycle: verified the site key, verified CORS
(AllowOrigins: '*' at the API Gateway), verified the job creation endpoint
directly via curl and via a raw fetch() in the browser (both succeeded),
before finally diffing embed.js source to find apiBaseFromElement()'s
fallback chain.

aurit.us's own homepage embed script IS correct -- it explicitly sets
data-auritus-api="https://4o6atlkpeh.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com" --
so the bug never surfaces there. It only bites every OTHER site that copies
the quick-start snippet as written.

Two independent fixes worth doing, either one closes this:
1. Update README.md's quick-start snippet to always include data-auritus-api
   explicitly (simplest, but relies on every integrator reading closely).
2. Have boot()/createJob fail loudly instead of silently: when createJob
   throws, render a visible (even minimal) error state in a mounted host
   element instead of returning before mountPlayer() is ever called. Silent
   total absence is the worse failure mode regardless of root cause.

Filed alongside auritus-294fa6 (worker/admin-jobs issues from the same
integration session).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Corroborating evidence this is still an open, real gap: Ryan independently hit the same thing on 2026-09-11/12 wiring the Auritus demo site's own examples (commits 2f70678, 640a535 -- adding data-auritus-api to site/components/AuritusEmbed.tsx and each example page). That fixed the demo site's own instances but never touched apiBaseFromElement()'s default or the README quick-start snippet, so the underlying trap is still live for the next integrator who copies the README as written. Recommendation #1 (fix the README snippet) is the cheap, high-leverage half of this; recommendation #2 (fail loudly instead of silently) is still undone anywhere.
